summary.text: The Calamity Beasts are huge, non-sapient elemental creatures of Bloomburrow, living seasons whose migrations bring disaster and seasonal change.

bio.text: In the distant Season of Chaos the animalfolk survived underground, and after developing weaving they won their first victories against the weaker beasts.
When great weaving was gone the beasts returned, and the animalfolk learned to cope with specialized small weaving, forming Valley's civilization.
Lily Emberseed repelled the beasts, ending the War of Cinders.
A mischievous interloper nearly caused an apocalypse by trying to control them, after which the ratfolk became secretive.
Visions of Valley's destruction by the beasts haunted King Glarb for many seasons, and he hired Cruelclaw to steal a Calamity Beast's egg, reawakening their fury.
The theft caused an unprecedented rampage by Maha and the other beasts, and Mabel called on all to help against them.
Mabel's group of small warriors and misfits returned the egg, stopping the beasts.

status.text: The beasts were stopped when Mabel's group returned the stolen egg, though they remain a recurring threat to Valley.
